capabilities: Render adversary statblocks from YAML fields in a note
List combat proficiencies with rating, damage, injury and special damage
Render description, special and ability fields as Markdown with wiki links
Choose hate or resolve and armour or armor labels automatically
extras: Installation is manual only per the README. The author warns that a statblock can silently fail to render if a field has the wrong format, and that Obsidian conventions like double brackets may need double quotes to parse as YAML.
intentEvidence: creating the 13th Age statblocks plugin from which this plugin is adapted
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display formatted RPG statblocks for The One Ring 2E adversaries in notes.

relations.evidence: the 13th Age statblocks plugin from which this plugin is adapted

summary: Renders The One Ring Second Edition adversary statblocks from YAML defined in notes, with linked features and abilities.
